item.title: How Miro Moved 70,000 Tests from Jest to Vitest
item.description: Jest ran 70,000 tests at 13 tests/sec with constant OOMs on CI. Here I explain how we migrated Miro's frontend monorepo to Vitest in 2 months with AI agents, achieving 50% faster runs and 30% less memory usage. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: The Tetris Script That Becomes Snake Once Prettified?
item.description: A formatter, minifier or deobfuscator can be made to turn one script into another. 186 techniques across 37+ JavaScript processors, from Chromium DevTools to WebCrack, plus a Tetris script that becomes Snake. (1 source: javascriptweekly)
